description: On June 9, I spent Election Day in Clinton, talking with residents as they headed to the polls. Residents generously shared their thoughts about the issues affecting their daily lives. Several themes emerged from those conversations and my follow-up discussions with the community: • Affordability remains the top concern. title: ​​100 Conversations Tour​ - What Town of Clinton Taught Me
